persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make a 10-second widescreen mood film: a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. Melancholy but peaceful, with gentle movement. Completely silent, no dialogue or text.
bank.Setting and mood: A lonely bus stop after rain at night; melancholy but peaceful.
bank.Visual style and camera movement: Gentle movement; other visual choices are your call.

messages.text: I'd like you to make a mood film showing a lonely bus stop after rain, late at night. I've been wanting something that captures that quiet feeling when the day is finally over. What I have in mind is 10 seconds long and widescreen, in 16:9, with a mood that's melancholy but peaceful. Please keep the movement gentle. It should be completely silent, with no dialogue or text.
